task_completion.description: The function f(x) = x^3 - 3x + 1 is correctly entered and plotted in GeoGebra.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for 'f(x) = x^3 - 3x + 1' in the Algebra View and a corresponding cubic curve in the Graphics View.

task_completion.description: The derivative f'(x) is plotted alongside the original function.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a second function (likely a parabola) labeled f'(x) or g(x) = 3x^2 - 3 in the Algebra View and plotted on the graph.

task_completion.description: An interactive tangent line is created that moves along the curve f(x).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a point on the curve f(x) and a line passing through that point that is tangent to the curve. The Algebra View should show a 'Tangent' command or a line equation that changes as the point moves.

task_completion.description: Critical points where f'(x) = 0 are identified on the graph.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for points marked at x = -1 and x = 1 (the local maximum and minimum). These may be identified using the 'Roots' of the derivative or 'Extremum' of the function.

task_completion.description: The instantaneous rate of change (slope) is displayed numerically.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a text box or a dynamic value in the Graphics View showing the slope of the tangent line or the value of f'(x) at the current point.

task_completion.description: The file is saved with the specific name 'derivative_explorer.ggb' in the correct directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for the GeoGebra window title bar showing 'derivative_explorer.ggb' or a file explorer/terminal window showing the file at ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/derivative_explorer.ggb.

integrity.description: The agent used the GeoGebra GUI to construct the visualization rather than just writing a file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the GeoGebra input bar, tools, or dragging points.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply display a static image or pre-made file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Algebra View should show the step-by-step construction of f(x), the derivative, and the tangent line.

integrity.description: The tangent line and rate of change should be dynamic, not static text.
integrity.visual_evidence: Check if the tangent line is attached to a point 'A' or similar variable that can be moved along the function f(x).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The function is f(x) = x^3 - 3x + 1. Its derivative is f'(x) = 3x^2 - 3. Critical points occur exactly at x = -1 (local max, y = 3) and x = 1 (local min, y = -1). The tangent line slope at any point x should equal 3x^2 - 3. The final filename must be 'derivative_explorer.ggb'.
